speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis; please tell me, did you recently have a urine culture performed, or have you noticed any changes in your urination such as burning or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your symptoms of fatigue, fever, and flank pain persist despite the resolution of your sinusitis, it is possible the initial infection has complicated or spread. Have you noticed any blood in your urine, or does the pain radiate toward your groin?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound
